messages.en:
Hey, {04 1f 00}, {07 0b 00}care to
join my exclusive walking
club, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}It's a special group that
gets together...um...right
now to walk...with me!
I'm a bit of a slow walker,
so just adjust yourself to
my pace, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

nüüd, et jalutada...minuga!

minu tempoga, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 14 00}Who says you need a reason
to go for a nice walk
around the neighborhood?
{07 0d 00}I have an idea, {04 1f 00}!
Why don't you join me
sometime?{01 01 00} {07 14 00}It'll be fun!

põhjust vaja?
{07 0d 00}Mul on mõte, {04 1f 00}!
Miks sa ei liitu minuga
kunagi?{01 01 00} {07 14 00}See tuleb lõbus!

Everyone needs exercise.
Even a fashion-forward
lass like me knows that.
{07 0d 00}In fact, taking a nice walk
with a friend is all the
rage right now!

{07 14 00}You like the entrepreneurial
type, eh? Well, he's a good
choice, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}And maybe he'd give you
a discount at the store!{01 01 00}
{07 09 00}But I kinda doubt it.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sulle meeldib ettevõtlik
tüüp, mis? Noh, ta on hea
valik, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}Ja ehk annaks ta sulle
poes allahindlust!{01 01 00}
{07 09 00}Aga ma kahtlen selles.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}He's a wise old bird. I'm
sure he can delight you for
HOURS with his stories.
{07 16 00}But {01 00 00 05 00}doesn't he sleep pretty
much all day long?

{07 06 00}I'm just wondering how much
time the two of you would
actually spend together!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ta on tark vana lind. Ma
olen kindel, et ta võib sind
TUNDE lugudega lõbustada.
{07 16 00}Aga {01 00 00 05 00}kas ta ei maga kogu
päeva otsa?

{07 06 00}Ma lihtsalt mõtlen, kui
aega te tegelikult koos
veedaksite!
